title: Grim Encounter
description: GM-only cinematic Start Encounter for Foundry VTT v14 + dnd5e, in the Grim black-and-red style: a small floating launcher, a fire intro in any colour you choose, simultaneous d20 initiative dice skinned with each player's Dice So Nice look, an arched-card initiative order, and automatic combat start. Follows Grim Core's theme.

recommends.reason: Initiative dice use each player's Dice So Nice colorset, texture, material and font.
One panel that themes every Grim module together.
